description: List a repository's components with their coverage. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/components/.

branch.description: Branch to report components on (defaults to the default branch).

owner.description: Owner username — the organization or user login on the git service, e.g. 'codecov' (required).

service.description: Git service provider — one of 'github' (default), 'gitlab', 'bitbucket', 'github_enterprise', 'gitlab_enterprise' or 'bitbucket_server'.

sha.description: Commit SHA to report components on.

name: codecov_list_components
title: List components
